hints.text: Subtraction works column by column, so each digit must sit under a digit with the same place value. Line up the decimal points first.
Write $5.6$ as $5.60$ so both numbers have two decimal places. Then work out $5.60 - 2.84$ from the right, regrouping when the top digit is too small.
After regrouping, $5.60 - 2.84 = 2.76$, so the difference is $2.76$.

explanation: Line up the decimal points and write $5.6$ as $5.60$ so both numbers have a hundredths digit.
Hundredths: $0 - 4$ is not possible, so regroup one tenth as ten hundredths and compute $10 - 4 = 6$.
Tenths: only $5$ tenths remain, and $5 - 8$ needs regrouping too, so take one whole and compute $15 - 8 = 7$.
Ones: $4$ ones remain, and $4 - 2 = 2$. Reading the digits with the point in place, the answer is $2.76$.
